issues.title: Sub-module GWT stubs
issues.why: AC-12 mandates GWT tables for sub-modules (01, 02, 03), but the provided context only shows the parent §97 and a partial §97 for 01/03-retrospectives, leaving other sub-modules with behavior but no local ACs.
issues.fix: Add at least one GWT-style acceptance criterion to the §97 file of every sub-module folder.

issues.title: Integer vs Prefixed Code Ambiguity
issues.why: AC-03 and AC-04 define two different formats (Integer 7000-7919 vs Regex ^[A-Z]{2,4}-...) without explicitly stating which takes precedence for cross-stack Go-to-PHP communication.
issues.fix: Add a 'Format Selection' rule: Go-internal uses Integer; all cross-stack/API-envelope errors MUST use Prefixed.

issues.title: Truncated Verification Patterns
issues.why: The file 01-frontend-backend-sync.md is referenced in inventories but its content is missing/truncated, preventing a coder from seeing the actual pattern.
issues.fix: Ensure 01-frontend-backend-sync.md content is fully inlined or provided in the bundle.
